name: La Familia Taqueria
eyebrow: Mexican restaurant · Hwy 6 S, College Station
tagline: Breakfast tacos, lunch specials and an all-you-can-eat buffet on Highway 6 South.
about: La Familia Taqueria is a family-friendly Mexican restaurant on State Highway 6 South in College Station, near Tower Point.
They serve breakfast tacos, lunch specials and hearty plates, with an all-you-can-eat buffet. Takeout and delivery are available.
address: 4152 State Hwy 6 S, College Station, TX 77845
hours_source: Hours as listed on Yelp and Visit College Station; call ahead to confirm.
